# PowerLaw_Analysis

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A statistical method that fits power-law distributions to EEG signal features (e.g., amplitude, inter-event intervals) to quantify scale-invariant behavior. Offers a computationally efficient feature extraction approach suitable for in-network processing and neuromorphic hardware with limited resources.
